data.name: 5'TOP mRNA
data.description: Class of mRNAs with a 5' terminal oligopyrimidine tract encoding ribosomal proteins and translation factors; their translation is a canonical output of mTORC1 signaling.
data.description_beginner: A group of messenger RNAs (the templates cells read to build proteins) that mostly encode the protein-building machinery itself. Turning their translation on is one of mTORC1's classic, best-established jobs.

studies.title: Translational repression of 5' TOP mRNAs in chronically activated CD8+ T cells.
studies.authors: Pledger ES; Ambavaram N; Ferguson L; Cate JHD

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.finding: Ribosome profiling of exhausted human CD8+ T cells reveals marked repression of 5'TOP mRNAs despite elevated mTOR activity, uncovering a layer of translational control that overrides or bypasses mTOR in T cell exhaustion.

studies.title: mTOR inactivation governs adaptive survival to ribosome biogenesis deficiency
studies.authors: Fan W; Liu H; Yang L; Sinha N; Catipovic M; Dong D; Easawaran H; Green R; Laiho M

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.model_system: Human cancer cell lines (functional genomics/CRISPR screens)
studies.finding: mTORC1 inhibition does not restore ribosome biogenesis but redistributes limited ribosomes away from highly-translated 5'TOP mRNAs toward survival-essential transcripts, defining a 'translational fitness' mechanism that lets cancer cells survive ribosome biogenesis deficiency.

studies.title: Lsp2 links mTORC1 to TOP mRNA translation and lifespan in Drosophila
studies.authors: Wang J; Cai Z; Gu J; Xiong S; Yi J; Yang M; Chang K; Ning X; Wen Y; Yan Y; Lu J; Wang Y; Zhai Z

evidence.label: Animal model
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.model_system: Drosophila melanogaster — Lsp2 genetic ablation, lifespan assay, translatomic (ribosome profiling) analysis
studies.finding: Identifies Lsp2, a Drosophila fat-body storage protein, as an amino-acid-induced feedback activator of mTORC1 that specifically boosts translation of TOP-motif mRNAs (mostly ribosomal proteins) via 4E-BP — a rapamycin-resistant arm of mTORC1 output. Genetic loss of Lsp2 reduces TOP mRNA translation and robustly extends lifespan without cost to reproduction, revealing a rapamycin-independent route from mTORC1 activity to organismal longevity.
